clips.title: The story
paras: At Silverwing Grove, Sentinel Farsong helps defend Ashenvale’s southern border. She rallies champions against the Warsong Outriders in Warsong Gulch.

Sentinel Farsong keeps watch at Silverwing Grove as the Warsong clan cuts lumber and advances into night elf lands. She calls Alliance champions to strike at Warsong Outriders and sends field reports to Silverwing command. Her work helps check the Horde’s expansion and protect the woods.
